sections.title: 廣東話 / 粵語
sections.body: Both names mean Cantonese. It is widely spoken in Hong Kong.

items.label: Cantonese
items.body: A distinct spoken Chinese language with six tones.

items.label: Mandarin
items.body: A different spoken Chinese language and the basis of the modern written standard.

cards.title: Spoken Cantonese
cards.body: Everyday conversation uses colloquial Cantonese grammar and vocabulary. We learn this first.

cards.title: Standard Written Chinese
cards.body: The formal written standard is closer to Mandarin-based grammar and can be read aloud with Cantonese pronunciations.

cards.title: Characters and sound
cards.body: Characters normally carry meaning. Cantonese also uses some phonetic loans, but characters are not generally sound without meaning.

items.label: Traditional
items.body: Used in Hong Kong and taught in this course.

items.label: Simplified
items.body: A different written form of many of the same words.
